input.question: What rights have we as Americans lost since 9/11?
input.ground_truth: Among others: * Rights to privacy - There is extensive monitoring of communications, including email and phones. It's hard to know exactly what is being monitored because it's a secret. * Rights to due process - More than one American citizen has been either held in prison (Jose Padilla) or executed (Anwar al-Aulaqi) without a trial, because there was a charge against them. They couldn't fight these charges because the charges themselves were state secrets that couldn't be revealed by the prosecutors. * Rights to freedom of speech - More than one US citizen has been put in jail because they were charged with supporting terrorists in indirect ways. In at least one case the person was charged with supporting terrorism because he made a YouTube video. I'll write more if I get a minute, but these are just a few examples from the past 12 years of changes to US domestic policies.
